properties.name: app.kafka.consumer.enabled
properties.description: Enable the sample Kafka consumer. Requires kafka module. Default false.

properties.name: app.modules.persistence.enabled
properties.description: Enable JPA + Flyway + PostgreSQL module. Default false.

properties.name: app.modules.redis.enabled
properties.description: Enable Redis cache backend. Default false.

properties.name: app.modules.security.enabled
properties.description: Enable OAuth2 JWT resource server. Default false (permit-all).

properties.name: app.modules.outbox.enabled
properties.description: Enable transactional outbox. Requires persistence + kafka. Default false.

properties.name: app.modules.docs.enabled
properties.description: Enable OpenAPI + Swagger UI. Default true.

properties.name: app.idempotency.ttl
properties.description: How long idempotency keys are retained. Default 24h.

properties.name: app.outbox.batch-size
properties.description: Outbox relay claim batch size. Default 50.

properties.name: app.outbox.max-attempts
properties.description: Outbox attempts before operator attention. Default 10.

properties.name: app.outbox.send-timeout
properties.description: Outbox relay per-send blocking timeout. Default 10s.

properties.name: app.api.version
properties.description: Public API version surfaced in OpenAPI metadata.
